rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a small piece broken off from something.

example.english: There’s a glass fragment on the ground, so be careful when walking.
example.traditional: 地上有塊玻璃碎片，行路小心啲。
example.jyutping: dei6 soeng6 jau5 faai3 bo1 lei4 seoi3 pin3 haang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this for a fragment or excerpt of writing, speech, memory, or another non-physical whole rather than a broken physical piece.

example.english: I only remember a fragment of what he said.
example.traditional: 我淨係記得佢講過嘅說話片段。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 gei3 dak1 keoi5 gong2 gwo3 ge3 syut3 waa6 pin3 dyun6
